-health-check.name: -health-check

list-contacts.name: list-contacts

get-contact.name: get-contact

create-contact.name: create-contact
create-contact.description: Create a new contact in Holded.

update-contact.name: update-contact
update-contact.description: Update an existing contact in Holded by its ID.

delete-contact.name: delete-contact

search-contacts.name: search-contacts
search-contacts.description: Search contacts in Holded by name. Returns matching contacts with key fields mapped to a curated output.

list-contact-groups.name: list-contact-groups
list-contact-groups.description: List contact groups from Holded. Contact groups are used to organize contacts into categories or segments. Supports pagination via page and limit.

list-invoices.name: list-invoices

get-invoice.name: get-invoice

create-invoice.name: create-invoice
create-invoice.description: Create a new invoice in Holded.

update-invoice.name: update-invoice

delete-invoice.name: delete-invoice

approve-invoice.name: approve-invoice

find-invoices.name: find-invoices

get-invoice-pdf.name: get-invoice-pdf

list-estimates.name: list-estimates
list-estimates.description: List estimates (quotes) from Holded. Returns estimates with id, number, date, contact, total, and status. Supports pagination.

params.limit: Results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-estimate.name: get-estimate
get-estimate.description: Get a single estimate from Holded by its ID.

list-proformas.name: list-proformas
list-proformas.description: List proformas from Holded. Supports pagination and filtering.

get-proforma.name: get-proforma

list-credit-notes.name: list-credit-notes
list-credit-notes.description: List credit notes from Holded. Supports pagination and filtering.

params.limit: Results per page (default: 25)

get-credit-note.name: get-credit-note
get-credit-note.description: Get a single credit note from Holded by its ID.

list-recurring-invoices.name: list-recurring-invoices
list-recurring-invoices.description: List recurring invoices from Holded. Supports pagination.

params.limit: Results per page (default: 25)

get-recurring-invoice.name: get-recurring-invoice
get-recurring-invoice.description: Get a single recurring invoice from Holded by its ID.

list-sales-receipts.name: list-sales-receipts
list-sales-receipts.description: List sales receipts from Holded. Supports pagination.

params.limit: Results per page (default: 25)
params.status: Filter by status (e.g. draft, sent, paid)

list-services.name: list-services
list-services.description: List services from Holded. Services are non-physical sellable items.

params.limit: Results per page (default: 25)

list-sales-channels.name: list-sales-channels
list-sales-channels.description: List sales channels from Holded. Sales channels track different distribution sources.

list-numbering-series.name: list-numbering-series
list-numbering-series.description: List numbering series from Holded for a specific document type. Numbering series define document numbering patterns per type.

params.documentType: Document type to list numbering series for (e.g. invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, estimate, proform, waybill, salesorder, purchase, purchaserefund, order, purchaseshipment, receiptnote, productionorder)

list-products.name: list-products
list-products.description: List products from Holded. Returns a curated list of products with id, name, SKU, price, cost price, stock, category, type, and tax info. Supports pagination via page and limit.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-product.name: get-product
get-product.description: Get a single product from Holded by its ID. Returns full product details including price, cost price, stock, category, type, unit type, and tax info.

create-product.name: create-product
create-product.description: Create a new product in Holded.

params.name: Product name
params.unit_type: Unit of measure (e.g. pcs, kg, hours)

update-product.name: update-product
update-product.description: Update an existing product in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional.

delete-product.name: delete-product
delete-product.description: Delete a product from Holded by its ID.

list-warehouses.name: list-warehouses
list-warehouses.description: List warehouses from Holded. Warehouses are storage locations for product inventory. Supports pagination via page and limit.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-warehouse.name: get-warehouse
get-warehouse.description: Get a single warehouse from Holded by its ID. Returns warehouse details including name, address, and default status.

list-price-lists.name: list-price-lists
list-price-lists.description: List price lists from Holded. Price lists define custom pricing tiers for different customer segments. Supports pagination via page and limit.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-price-list.name: get-price-list
get-price-list.description: Get a single price list from Holded by its ID, including the full list of product prices.

list-accounting-accounts.name: list-accounting-accounts
list-accounting-accounts.description: List accounting accounts (chart of accounts) from Holded. Returns accounts with id, code, name, group, and balance.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.group: Filter by account group (e.g. assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses)

list-ledger-entries.name: list-ledger-entries
list-ledger-entries.description: List ledger entries from Holded. Returns journal entries with date, account, debit/credit amounts, and description. If no date range is provided, defaults to the current calendar year.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.endDate: Filter entries up to this date (ISO 8601)

list-expenses-accounts.name: list-expenses-accounts
list-expenses-accounts.description: List expenses accounts from Holded. These are accounts used for tracking business expenses.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-expenses-account.name: get-expenses-account
get-expenses-account.description: Get a single expenses account from Holded by its ID.

list-payments.name: list-payments
list-payments.description: List payments from Holded. Returns payments with id, date, amount, contact, method, and related document info.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.endDate: Filter payments up to this date (ISO 8601)

get-payment.name: get-payment
get-payment.description: Get a single payment from Holded by its ID.

create-payment.name: create-payment
create-payment.description: Create a new payment in Holded. Payments can be linked to invoices or other documents.

params.contactId: Contact ID the payment is associated with
params.documentType: Type of related document (e.g. invoice, expense)

update-payment.name: update-payment
update-payment.description: Update an existing payment in Holded by its ID.

delete-payment.name: delete-payment
delete-payment.description: Delete a payment from Holded by its ID.

list-taxes.name: list-taxes
list-taxes.description: List taxes from Holded. Returns tax rates with id, name, percentage, and type.

list-purchases.name: list-purchases
list-purchases.description: List purchases from Holded. Returns purchase records with id, number, date, supplier, total, and status. Supports pagination.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.contactId: Filter purchases by supplier contact ID
params.status: Filter by purchase status (e.g. draft, sent, paid)

get-purchase.name: get-purchase
get-purchase.description: Get a single purchase from Holded by its ID, including line items and full details.

create-purchase.name: create-purchase
create-purchase.description: Create a new purchase (supplier invoice) in Holded. Requires an existing supplier contactId and at least one item. Returns the created purchase with its id.

params.contactId: Supplier contact ID (required — must be an existing contact)
params.tags: Tags to assign to the purchase

update-purchase.name: update-purchase
update-purchase.description: Update an existing purchase in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional.

params.tags: Tags to assign to the purchase

delete-purchase.name: delete-purchase
delete-purchase.description: Delete a purchase from Holded by its ID.

attach-purchase-file.name: attach-purchase-file
attach-purchase-file.description: Attach a file (e.g. the supplier invoice PDF) to a Holded purchase. Uploads real multipart/form-data with the file under the `file` field — max 10 MB. Provide either dataUrl (data:<mime>;base64,<payload>) or a raw base64 string, plus a filename. Returns the attachment info.

params.contentType: MIME type (e.g. 'application/pdf'). Defaults from dataUrl or octet-stream.
params.dataUrl: Data URI scheme — exact format `data:<mime>;base64,<base64Payload>`. Either this or base64 is required.

list-purchase-attachments.name: list-purchase-attachments
list-purchase-attachments.description: List files attached to a Holded purchase by its ID.

list-banking-accounts.name: list-banking-accounts
list-banking-accounts.description: List banking accounts from Holded. Returns bank accounts with id, name, bank, IBAN, balance, and currency.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-banking-account.name: get-banking-account
get-banking-account.description: Get a single banking account from Holded by its ID.

list-banking-movements.name: list-banking-movements
list-banking-movements.description: List banking movements for a specific Holded bank account. Returns transactions with date, amount, description, and reconciliation status.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.endDate: Filter movements up to this date (ISO 8601)

list-payment-methods.name: list-payment-methods
list-payment-methods.description: List payment methods from Holded. Payment methods define how invoices and payments are processed.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-payment-method.name: get-payment-method
get-payment-method.description: Get a single payment method from Holded by its ID.

list-remittances.name: list-remittances
list-remittances.description: List remittances from Holded. Remittances are batch payment collections (typically SEPA direct debits).

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.status: Filter by remittance status (e.g. draft, sent, processed)

get-remittance.name: get-remittance
get-remittance.description: Get a single remittance from Holded by its ID.

list-funnels.name: list-funnels
list-funnels.description: List CRM funnels from Holded. Funnels represent sales pipelines with stages that leads move through.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-funnel.name: get-funnel
get-funnel.description: Get a single CRM funnel from Holded by its ID, including its stages.

list-leads.name: list-leads
list-leads.description: List CRM leads from Holded. Returns leads with id, name, email, phone, stage, funnel, and value. Supports pagination and filtering by funnel and stage.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-lead.name: get-lead
get-lead.description: Get a single CRM lead from Holded by its ID, with full detail including description, tags, and custom fields.

create-lead.name: create-lead
create-lead.description: Create a new CRM lead in Holded.

params.name: Lead name (required)
params.funnelId: Funnel ID to place the lead in
params.expectedCloseDate: Expected close date (ISO date string, e.g. 2026-12-31)

update-lead.name: update-lead
update-lead.description: Update an existing CRM lead in Holded by its ID. All fields are optional — only provided fields are updated.

params.name: Lead name
params.tags: Tags to assign to the lead

update-lead-stage.name: update-lead-stage
update-lead-stage.description: Move a CRM lead to a different stage within its funnel. This is the primary action for advancing leads through the sales pipeline.

list-projects.name: list-projects
list-projects.description: List projects from Holded. Returns a curated list of projects with id, name, description, status, budget, dates, and contact. Supports pagination via page and limit.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)

get-project.name: get-project
get-project.description: Get a single project from Holded by its ID. Returns full project details including name, description, status, budget, dates, and contact.

get-project-summary.name: get-project-summary
get-project-summary.description: Get a summary of a Holded project including financial and time metrics such as budget usage, total time, and task counts.

list-tasks.name: list-tasks
list-tasks.description: List tasks from Holded. Returns tasks with id, name, status, assignee, project, and dates. Supports filtering by project and status, plus pagination.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.status: Filter by task status (e.g. todo, in_progress, done)

get-task.name: get-task
get-task.description: Get a single task from Holded by its ID.

create-task.name: create-task
create-task.description: Create a new task in Holded.

params.name: Task name
params.projectId: ID of the project this task belongs to
params.assigneeId: ID of the assigned team member

list-project-time-entries.name: list-project-time-entries
list-project-time-entries.description: List time entries for a specific Holded project. Returns time entries with id, date, duration, user, and task info. Supports date range filtering and pagination.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.
params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)
params.startDate: Filter entries on or after this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)
params.endDate: Filter entries on or before this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

list-all-time-entries.name: list-all-time-entries

list-employees.name: list-employees
list-employees.description: List employees from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, name, email, phone, department, position, status, startDate, and timestamps. Supports pagination.

get-employee.name: get-employee
get-employee.description: Get a single employee from Holded by their ID. Returns full employee details including name, email, phone, department, position, status, and dates.

list-employee-time-entries.name: list-employee-time-entries
list-employee-time-entries.description: List time tracking entries for a specific Holded employee. Returns clock-in/out records with dates and durations. Supports date range filtering and pagination.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.
params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)
params.startDate: Filter entries on or after this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)
params.endDate: Filter entries on or before this date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

list-all-employee-time-entries.name: list-all-employee-time-entries
list-all-employee-time-entries.description: List time tracking entries across all Holded employees. Returns clock-in/out records with dates and durations. Cursor-paginated: pass the cursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

params.cursor: Pagination cursor returned by the previous response. Omit to start from the first page.
params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 200)

list-payslips.name: list-payslips
list-payslips.description: List payslips from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, employee, period, gross/net amounts, and status. Supports filtering by employee, status, and period, plus pagination.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.status: Filter by payslip status (e.g. draft, approved, paid)
params.period: Filter by pay period (e.g. 2026-01 for January 2026)

get-payslip.name: get-payslip
get-payslip.description: Get a single payslip from Holded by its ID. Returns full payslip details including employee, period, gross/net amounts, deductions, taxes, and status.

list-time-off-requests.name: list-time-off-requests
list-time-off-requests.description: List time-off requests from Holded. Returns a curated list with id, employee, type, dates, and approval status. Supports filtering by employee, status, and type, plus pagination.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 50)

params.employeeId: Filter by employee ID. When provided, queries the per-employee endpoint.
params.status: Filter by approval status (e.g. pending, accepted, rejected, cancelled)
params.timeOffTypeId: Filter by time-off type ID (e.g. holiday, sick leave, vacation)

params.startDateTo: Start date upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-31). Required by the API. Defaults to the end of the current year.

get-time-off-request.name: get-time-off-request
get-time-off-request.description: Get a single time-off request from Holded by its ID. Returns full details including employee, type, dates, days, approval status, and approver info.

params.employeeId: The Holded employee ID (24-character hex ObjectId)
params.id: The Holded time-off request ID (24-character hex ObjectId)

list-events.name: list-events
list-events.description: List calendar events from Holded. Returns events with id, title, start/end dates, all-day flag, location, and attendees. Supports pagination and date range filtering.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.startDate: Filter events starting from this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)
params.endDate: Filter events ending before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

get-event.name: get-event
get-event.description: Get a single calendar event from Holded by its ID.

create-event.name: create-event
create-event.description: Create a new calendar event in Holded. Requires a title, start date, and end date.

params.title: Event title
params.allDay: Whether this is an all-day event

list-inbox-documents.name: list-inbox-documents
list-inbox-documents.description: List inbox documents from Holded. The inbox contains documents received from external sources. Returns documents with id, name, status, type, and timestamps. Supports pagination and status filtering.

params.limit: Number of results per page (default: 25, max: 100)
params.status: Filter by document status (e.g. pending, processed, rejected)

get-inbox-document.name: get-inbox-document
get-inbox-document.description: Get a single inbox document from Holded by its ID.

get-api-usage.name: get-api-usage
get-api-usage.description: Get API usage statistics for the current Holded account. Shows request counts, rate limit info, and overall usage.

params.startDate: Start date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)
params.endDate: End date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

get-api-usage-by-type.name: get-api-usage-by-type
get-api-usage-by-type.description: Get API usage statistics broken down by a specific type (e.g. "requests", "errors"). Returns usage details for the given type.

params.type: The usage type to filter by (e.g. "requests", "errors")
params.startDate: Start date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)
params.endDate: End date for usage period (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

list-webhooks.name: list-webhooks
list-webhooks.description: List all webhooks configured in Holded. Webhooks are HTTP callbacks that notify your application when events occur.

get-webhook.name: get-webhook
get-webhook.description: Get a single webhook from Holded by its ID. Returns full webhook details including URL, subscribed events, and enabled status.

create-webhook.name: create-webhook
create-webhook.description: Create a new webhook in Holded. The webhook will receive HTTP POST callbacks for the specified events at the given URL.

params.url: The URL where webhook events will be delivered (must be HTTPS)
params.events: Array of event types to subscribe to (e.g. ["contact.created", "invoice.paid"]). Use list-webhook-events to see available events.

update-webhook.name: update-webhook
update-webhook.description: Update an existing webhook in Holded. Can modify the URL, subscribed events, or enabled status.

params.url: The new URL where webhook events will be delivered (must be HTTPS)
params.events: New array of event types to subscribe to

delete-webhook.name: delete-webhook
delete-webhook.description: Delete a webhook from Holded by its ID. This permanently removes the webhook and stops all event deliveries to its URL.

list-webhook-events.name: list-webhook-events
list-webhook-events.description: List all supported webhook event types in Holded. Use this to discover which events you can subscribe to when creating or updating webhooks.

name: Holded
description: Full Holded ERP integration — manage contacts, CRM leads, invoices, estimates, proformas, credit notes, recurring invoices, products, inventory, accounting, payments, treasury, banking, projects, tasks, team/HR, calendar events, inbox documents, and developer tools via Holded REST API v2 with Bearer token authentication

changelog.notes: Full API v2 integration — 94 tools covering all major Holded modules: CRM (contacts, contact groups, leads, funnels, tags), Invoicing (invoices, estimates, proformas, credit notes, recurring invoices, sales receipts, services, sales channels, numbering series), Products & Inventory (products, warehouses, price lists), Accounting (chart of accounts, ledger entries, expenses accounts, payments, purchases, taxes), Treasury (banking accounts, movements, payment methods, remittances), Projects (projects, tasks, time entries, summaries), Team & HR (employees, time tracking, payslips, time-off requests), Calendar (events), Inbox (documents), and Developer tools (API usage, webhooks). Includes full CRUD operations where supported by the API.
Initial release — browse and look up your Holded clients, suppliers and leads, and review invoices with statuses and totals
